reasons: system.mem.total maps to system.memory.limit (sum, By), and the candidate's second formula sum(limit) - sum(available) reproduces query2 - query1 with the same unit and aggregation.

system.mem.usable is mapped to system.linux.memory.available, which is Linux-only, so hosts on other OSes may yield different or missing series; this is a series-coverage caveat, not a quantity mismatch.
system.linux.memory.available is defined but not in the dataset; that is still a valid translation.
Datadog's $scope has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it to all series is correct; no grouping is applied on either side.
